volkswagen-id-buzz-cargo.note: Rear motor standard; ID. Buzz Cargo Pro 4MOTION (two motors, 250 kW / 340 PS) listed by ADAC from 06/2026 (first version 08/2024)

volkswagen-id-tiguan.note: Trend/Life 58 kWh (190 PS) and the 286 PS versions are rear-wheel drive; 4MOTION (299 PS, 77 kWh) on Life and R-Line, orders open since October 2026

audi-q5.note: Q5 and Q5 Sportback 2.0 TFSI MHEV plus (150 kW) with front-wheel drive (ADAC: Vorderrad, from 07/2025); TDI, e-hybrid and SQ5 are quattro

mazda-mazda3.note: e-Skyactiv G 140 (2.5) is FWD only; i-Activ AWD optional with the e-Skyactiv X 186 and automatic (Mazda Germany, model year 2027)

mazda-cx-30.note: e-Skyactiv G 140 (2.5) is FWD only; i-Activ AWD optional with the e-Skyactiv X 186 automatic (Mazda Germany, model year 2027)

ebro-s900.note: Plug-in hybrid with 1.5T petrol and three motors (two front, one rear), 425 PS; the only version sold in Spain is 4x4

voyah-courage.note: Single-motor versions are rear-wheel drive (rear motor); the Norwegian importer also lists a two-motor 4WD version (320 kW)

voyah-free.note: Two-motor all-wheel drive only (360 kW / 489 PS); voyah.no now marks it as a discontinued model (used cars only), the Dutch importer still lists it

voyah-dream.note: Two-motor 4WD only (320 kW); voyah.no marks it as discontinued (used cars only), the Dutch importer still lists it

hongqi-eh7.note: Norway: Premium and Exclusive with two-motor AWD (619 PS); Netherlands/Belgium also sell the single-motor rear-drive version (344 PS), 85 or 111 kWh

hongqi-ehs7.note: Norway: Premium and Exclusive with 4WD only (619 PS, 85 or 111 kWh); the Netherlands also get a rear-wheel-drive version

hongqi-e-hs9.note: All three Norwegian versions are AWD (551 PS); only the Exclusive+ (120 kWh) is currently orderable, Premium and Exclusive are marked temporarily sold out

farizon-sv.note: Single front motor driving the front wheels; no AWD version

farizon-v7e.note: Single front motor (100 kW), front-wheel drive per the Australian spec sheet; no AWD version

ford-transit-city.note: JMC-built electric van; the 110 kW motor drives the front wheels. Orders from Q2 2026, first deliveries Q4 2026

maxus-edeliver-7.note: Front-wheel drive standard; an all-wheel-drive version with two motors is offered in Germany since February 2025. Diesel Deliver 7 is FWD

maxus-edeliver-5-van-mid.note: Front-mounted 120 kW motor on every version (UK launch report); no AWD

dr-dr-1-0-ev.note: Rear-wheel drive ('la trazione è posteriore'), 45 kW motor; Italy only

kgm-tivoli.note: 1.5 T-GDI (163 PS) with 2WD or 4WD; KGM Switzerland advertises the Tivoli Steel as 'der günstigste 4x4 der Schweiz' and Swiss dealers list new 2026 Tivoli 4WD cars

kgm-musso-ev.note: Germany: 2WD (single 152 kW motor) with optional 4x4 (two motors, 175 kW); Switzerland sells the 4WD only

xpeng-g6.note: RWD Standard Range and Long Range; AWD Performance (two motors) orderable in Germany since July 2025 (51,600 EUR)
